source: TomTom Traffic Flow API v4 (flowSegmentData, zoom 14), free evaluation key
note: Real-time snapshot, evening peak. One request per sampled major road (motorway..tertiary) in each study box, made by `uv run python -m urban.live <area>`. ratio = current / free-flow speed (same measure as speed_rel in edge_stats.json). edge = SUMO edge id the point was sampled on. confidence 1 = fully live.
